sloka: कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तार जाम्बवतोः तथा ।दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटल सुनेत्रयोः ॥४-३३-११॥
transliteration: kumudasya suṣeṇasya tāra jāmbavatoḥ tathā ।dadhivaktrasya nīlasya supāṭala sunetrayoḥ ॥4-33-11॥

translations.english: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)
